create_code_execution_tool: create the OpenAI-format tool definition for litellm_code_execution in a sandboxed environment
create_anthropic_code_execution_tool: create the Anthropic-format tool definition for litellm_code_execution in a sandboxed environment
test_has_code_execution_tool: test if a list of tools contains the litellm_code_execution tool
add_code_execution_tool: add the litellm_code_execution tool to a tools list if not already present
run_code_execution_handler: run the CodeExecutionHandler to execute LLM calls with automatic code execution in a sandbox
